⭐ **1-Star Review – VEG ER**

I was extremely disappointed with my experience at VEG ER. Their prices were **well over double what I ended up paying at another veterinary clinic down the road for treatment of the exact same diagnosis.

The veterinarian never personally discussed the treatment plan with me, despite documenting in the medical record that she had. Instead, a veterinary technician explained the plan. Additionally, VEG never confirmed the proposed treatment plan with Pet Poison Control, something my current veterinarian took the time to do to ensure my pet was receiving the appropriate care.

During an emergency involving a potentially life-threatening situation, pet owners deserve transparency, clear communication, and a sense of urgency. Unfortunately, I did not feel that any of those were priorities during my visit.

**My experience left me feeling that financial considerations were prioritized over my pet's immediate medical needs.** When someone brings their beloved pet to an emergency veterinary hospital, they are already frightened and vulnerable. They should not have to question whether they are being charged fairly or whether the recommended treatment has been thoroughly evaluated.

Thankfully, I found another veterinary clinic nearby that provided the care my pet needed at a fraction of the cost, with better communication and a treatment plan confirmed through Poison Control.

I would strongly encourage pet owners to compare emergency veterinary options whenever circumstances safely allow. **Higher prices do not necessarily mean better care.**

I don’t with the ER on anyone, but if you have to go, VEG is amazing! Loved being able to stay with my baby girl through the treatments.

You don't need to set up an appointment, and, while optional, can call and let them know of your pet's condition ahead of time, so I was able to get my cat seen asap. The staff were more than kind and caring towards not only our cat, but us as well, updating us during the wait times, helping us set up payment, and providing free refreshments. You will be told exactly what your pet needs and how much everything will cost upfront before they do anything, so there's no sudden surprises after a procedure. They also sent a referral to another veterinary service, so we could get our cat seen much faster. I honestly can't recommend this place enough. My dogs eye was hurt and they made sure to properly treat him and made sure I knew everything that was happening. They comforted me and my baby. I couldn’t have asked for a better staff to take care of my baby. They prescribed the medication for him and just two days later he’s already feeling better day by day. I made a call to VEG-ER earlier today and had a very concerning call with the receptionist that I wanted to share in case anyone is considering bringing their pets here. I called due to some eye issues my dog was having; nothing was bulging or swelling, however her eye was very red and she was squinting a lot to the point that I was concerned enough to call in an effort to find a good place to take her in. I explained this to the receptionist on the phone and made it very clear that her eye was still able to somewhat open and she was alert. The lady on the phone immediately started diagnosing over the phone and stated things like: “Okay so we may need to remove the eye”. It was incredibly jarring to an already high stress situation as someone seeking emergency help. I am curious if this was some kind of scare tactic to get me to bring her in, but it only convinced me NOT to take her there and seek help elsewhere. On the phone, I did  assure her multiple times that the eye was still opening and that removal was an extreme response. She then kept addressing my dogs eye using past tense verbiage and continued to talk about my dogs eye being “salvageable”.
After that, I no longer felt comfortable working with this vet in fear that only the extreme would be the chosen outcome. I do not believe the receptionist was reasonable or empathetic to my concerns and I would not recommend this vet in the instance of an emergency with pets.

It’s taken me over a month to be able to write this, but I feel it’s important to share my experience. Our dog, Bear, started having seizures back to back….basically any time he stood up. We called around and vets turned us away. Took him to Mission vet and they wouldn’t let us be with him and put him at the back of the line because he wasn’t seizing unless he stood. They recommended Veg and I hadn’t heard of them. I called and they said to bring him in, they were ready to help. We brought him in and had a vet and techs immediately at our side helping him. They quickly provided options, which unfortunately led to him crossing the rainbow bridge. They entire staff were patient and accommodating as our family trickled in to say goodbye. They are an amazing group of people and I will recommend them to anyone who has pets. If we ever feel ready to welcome another dog into our home, Veg will be our only spot to take them. I can’t express how grateful I am for their compassion, patience, and love as we navigated such a heartbreaking time. Thank you to everyone who works there. What you do will have a lasting effect not only on my family, but to everyone you help.

Incredibly disappointing experience. You would think that human beings could have more compassion and understanding for a family that was out of town and trying to make decisions about a treatment plan. We were told that our dog would undoubtedly return unless we spent $7,000+ on a treatment plan. This plan was scientifically required based upon the tests. It was "science" I remember the doctor saying.

How about calling the next morning to determine next steps? We were met with "can you get the person on the phone who will be picking your dog up so I don't have to repeat myself?" Is that how a professional doctor should talk to a patient's family? We had already spent more than $2,000 and this is the level of care we received.

They also tried to keep our dog unless we paid more than $700 for an additional test to prove the doctor's theory that our dog's prostate was enlarged. No thank you. I'm not paying to see whether or not your theory is correct.

We didn't listen to his science and our dog recovered well at home. Our experience was not one of care and treatment, but of high-pressure sales based upon emotional circumstances. I suppose if you have an endless amount of money and you never question why certain things must be done to your pet, then this is the place for you. We will never return.
Great staff, environment and care! Don’t hesitate to seek their help in an emergency or urgent care situation.
Exceptional experience and the Dr and staff were professional and very knowledgeable and keeping me in the loop. I loved the openness of the area where you can see what the staff is doing.

Oh my goodness! I am SO incredibly thankful we were recommended to VEG ER yesterday! ❤️ They treated my baby like he was their own, and I couldn’t be more grateful.

Going to our regular vet can be really difficult for him, so I had never seen him so happy, calm, and comfortable around a veterinary staff before. From the warm welcome, to triage, the vet assistants, and the doctor—every single person was absolutely amazing.

I’m honestly overwhelmed with tears thinking about how much love and care they showed my baby. 🥹❤️ The compassion they gave him meant more to me than I can even put into words.

I can’t recommend VEG ER enough! If you ever find yourself needing emergency care for your fur baby, this is definitely the place. 🐾
Highly recommend! Best pet ER I have been to! Appreciate to be able to be with pet during treatment. They helped my kitty in a crisis and through a very tough day.

i am writing this because i never want another person, or another pet, to experience what i experienced. i am only 17 years old, and i was home alone when i had to make this call. my french bulldog was having what appeared to be a life-threatening respiratory emergency. she was barely breathing. i was terrified and immediately called for veterinary help. i explained the situation to the person who answered the call. the first man I spoke with understood the seriousness and asked if I could get to a vet. I explained that I was 17 home alone, did not have a drivers license, and had no transportation. I asked if there was anything I could do to help my dog in the meantime, but instead I was told a doctor would have to speak with me and was put on hold. when I spoke to the doctor, I explained everything again and repeatedly asked if they could send anyone to help. I was told they couldn’t. I eventually found someone who could come pick me up and told the veterinarian. while I was waiting, my dog stopped breathing. I was still on the phone with the veterinarian, crying and panicking, repeatedly asking what I was supposed to do to keep my dog alive. I was given no CPR instructions, no rescue-breathing instructions, and no guidance on what to do while waiting. the person coming to pick me up was the one who had to tell me how to perform compressions and breathe into my dog’s mouth. I was literally on the phone with a veterinary professional while someone else was having to teach me how to try to save my dog’s life. I continued begging them to send someone, while the veterinarian kept asking how far away I was. My dog then went completely limp and began losing bodily control. the veterinarian told me, “im worried that shes passed already.” I was sobbing and still desperately hoping there was something I could do. The only practical help I received was having a check-in scheduled and being given the location of the nearest vet. I understand that they cannot guarantee an animal survives an emergency, and I understand they may not have been able to physically send someone. that is not what I am upset about. I am upset that while my dog was barely breathing and then stopped breathing, I repeatedly begged a veterinary professional for emergency guidance and was not given the instructions I desperately needed. I am a minor. I was home alone, terrified, trying to find transportation, and watching my dog deteriorate in front of me. I should not have had to figure out life-saving measures on my own while crying and begging for help. this was one of the most traumatic experiences I have ever gone through. I called because I believed I was reaching veterinary professionals who would guide me through an emergency. Instead, I felt completely helpless and abandoned while my dog was dying in front of me. I sincerely hope this service reevaluates its emergency protocol. no scared pet owner should have to feel as alone and helpless as I did.
The doctor and her staff were very friendly and professional. I hope to never need them again, but if I do I will definitely bring my baby back here.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about VEG ER for Pets in San Antonio. Fable and Dr. Charity quite literally saved our sweet puppy Buster’s life, and our family will forever be grateful to them.

We arrived in the middle of the night, around 3 a.m., scared and unsure of what was happening with Buster. From the moment we walked through the doors, they took us seriously and saw him immediately. There was no waiting around while we worried. They jumped right in, started evaluating him and made us feel like he was their most important patient.

What impressed us most was how incredibly thorough they were. Buster’s symptoms could easily have been dismissed as something minor, but Fable and Dr. Charity kept looking. They paid attention to the details, asked questions, ran the appropriate tests and ultimately caught a heart issue that we had no idea he had. Their diligence and expertise may very well have changed the course of his life.

Just as important as the medical care was the kindness they showed all of us. When your dog is sick, especially unexpectedly in the middle of the night, you are scared and exhausted and trying to process a lot of information at once. They understood that. They explained what they were seeing, what they were concerned about and what they were doing every step of the way. We never felt left in the dark or like we were bothering them with questions.

And despite it being 3 a.m., you would never have known it from their energy or level of care. They never slowed down. They were attentive, compassionate and completely focused on Buster. There was no sense that we had arrived at an inconvenient hour or that anyone was just trying to get through an overnight shift. They treated our puppy with the same urgency and tenderness I imagine they would give their own pets.

Fable was incredibly kind and reassuring throughout the entire experience, and Dr. Charity was exceptional. Her combination of expertise, thoroughness and compassion gave us confidence during a really frightening night. We knew Buster was in very capable hands.

Emergency veterinary care is one of those things you hope you never need, but when you do, you want people who understand that the animal in front of them isn’t “just a dog.” Buster is part of our family, and that is exactly how VEG treated him.

We walked into VEG scared and worried about our sweet puppy and left knowing that the team had identified something incredibly important that could have easily been missed. I will never forget that.

To Fable, Dr. Charity and the entire VEG San Antonio team: thank you for taking Buster immediately, for listening, for being so thorough, for communicating with us constantly and, most of all, for taking such wonderful care of our boy. You saved our puppy’s life, and there really aren’t enough stars for that.

If you ever find yourself needing emergency care for your pet in San Antonio, this is where I would go without hesitation.
The entire staff is friendly, genuine, and they care. Explained everything, and didn’t charge for services that weren’t needed. 10/10 recommend.

Very quick response. Kind and attentive with excellent communication.

I truly felt that my pet’s well-being was their priority, and I am incredibly grateful for the care we received. Thank you to Dr. Adams, Cristina, and the entire VEG Space ER team for an amazing experience. I would absolutely recommend VEG to anyone needing emergency veterinary care!

2 weeks ago today I brought my boy here for end of life care. I can finally write this review. I've only had to let go of 2 of my babies in my life, this was the 2nd. My first phone call was panicked, my baby was seizing and I was sobbing on the phone. Pulling up, they opened the doors for us, and we all stood discussing our options. We made our decision for euthanasia. From there we were taken to a little exam room with a black leather couch. The room was very private. We discussed payment with no rush while I gathered and transferred funds. They made sure my baby was safe while I paid up prior to anything else. (I must say, this is OBVIOUSLY, what should be done. However, the 1st time for me was payment AFTER and I was hysterically crying when asked to pay. We purchased a cremation package which included them taking care of everything after his passing. They told me to take as long as I needed to say goodbyes and to ring the doorbell when we were ready. They had a secluded seating area with water and snacks outside for anyone who didnt want to stay in the room. My husband went out there after we rang the doorbell. While he was out there, the staff approached him sincerely and asked him if he'd like anything while he waited and gave their respects. While I stayed in the room, the nurses told me the process from start to finish, told me what to expect and explained everything I needed to hear (I also did not get this first time around, *bulverde veterinary clinic*). They did first shot, gave me a moment to hear his last snores and breaths and one last goodbye hug, and 2nd shot. He looked at peace, like my sleeping angel. The nurses told me to stay with him as long as I needed, to just come out when I was ready. I stayed a while. I talked to him, held him, I really took my time. When I finally exited, the staff was all there, ready to each give me their condolences. It was so emotional, they were all truly apologetic and sympathetic. I really appreciated the care that they gave to my whole family while we were there. After that night, I called numerous times just asking questions about his memorial and cremation, they handled each call with the same sympathy-no rush-happy to help attitudes. The tech went above and beyond to get me my extra souvenirs from my boy, thank you person I never got to meet. I know Dominique was one of the people who I spoke to multiple times, so she should know who to thank for me! When we finally picked up my boy, I broke down in the parking lot. I love how there's zero judgement for people walking in with tears streaming. We sat and waited, husband grabbed a snack. And Samson was delivered to us in a velvet bag with his urn and pawprints. The Fond Memories cremation service did a beautiful job. Thank you VEG staff for making the worst day of my life, just a little easier. I highly recommend for end of life care, my baby was worth every penny spent here. They also offer military discount which helped us immensely.
